preconditions.description: The number of test cases is between 1 and 10, inclusive.
The length of the permutation is between 2 and 10^5, inclusive.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly T permutations.

postconditions.expression: all(len(p) == n for p in output)
postconditions.description: Each permutation in the output has length n.

postconditions.expression: all(all(1 <= p[i] <= n for i in range(n)) for p in output)
postconditions.description: Each permutation in the output contains integers in the range [1, n], inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(all(p[i] != i for i in range(n)) for p in output)
postconditions.description: Each permutation in the output is good, meaning no element is in its original position.

postconditions.expression: all(p == sorted(p) for p in output)
postconditions.description: Each permutation in the output is lexicographically smaller than any other permutation of the same length that is not good.
